clips.title: The speeding car rear-ended into the truck in front, and the front hood was blown open
clips.sha1_source: Wikimedia Commons imageinfo API, rechecked 2026-10-20; matched the downloaded file
clips.licence_limitations: PD-CCTV is a Commons community designation arguing that automatic recordings lack human authorship; it is not permission from the recorder or vehicle owner and is untested outside the United States. Treat as internal evaluation only.
clips.author: Unknown in-vehicle recorder; Commons author field reads 'CCTV footage does not create a copyright'
clips.provenance_notes: Commons copy of a Douyin repost; the original recording was not located. Frames carry the recorder's own overlay (date/time, speed, gear, indicators and a 17-character vehicle identifier, top-right). No platform watermark seen in the previewed frames; Commons thumbnails were viewed at 2, 8, 12, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22 and 27 s only, not the full clip.

collision_evidence.status: visually confirmed from preview stills; no human-confirmed annotation
collision_evidence.observation: Forward-facing in-vehicle camera on an expressway at about 108-120 km/h. A tarpaulin-covered truck is ahead in the ego lane at 20 s; at 21 s the bonnet has flown up and blocks the view; at 27 s the vehicle has stopped (0 km/h, gear P).
collision_evidence.labels_note: Impact time is bracketed from 1 s preview spacing only; ground-truth event timing and labels have not been established.
